decision: Retain valve on/off control; replace D1 with Q11 reverse-polarity stage only
limits: Rds increases with junction temperature; board thermal resistance not measured.
Zener operating current below 5mA means actual gate voltage differs from nominal10V.
Q11 alone is not a reverse-current blocker. U12 retained for downstream reverse-current blocking.
Input remains regulated12V; surge/hotplug/reversal behavior requires hardware measurement.
valve_basis: FA0520E two-position three-way valve has no manufacturer qualified PWM hold current/duty specification.
PCA9685 has one common PWM frequency for pumps and any added valve channels.
Retain existing firmware interface and default-off gate pull-downs.
